choices.why: It is the tallest option at 189 cm, with six shelves in a dark espresso wood that matches the floor, so it fits lots of books against the left wall.
The cognac leather armchair is comfortable and warm, and its wooden legs bring a mid-century touch to the corner by the window.
Its wood-look base and natural linen shade give the soft, warm light you want for reading and reinforce the natural-materials look.
At 58 cm it is the right height next to the armchair for your coffee, and its leather magazine sling suits a reading nook while the black frame echoes the window frames.
This round, light-colored natural jute rug, 152 cm across, fits under the armchair and side table and contrasts with the dark floor.
The cream woven throw with twisted fringe looks great on the cognac leather and adds a natural, cozy textile.
The natural beige linen-look curtains soften the black frames and the concrete ceiling while still letting light in.

answer.why: The dark wood of the bookcase and side table matches the floor, while the cognac leather, jute, linen and cream throw build a warm, natural palette. The touches of black in the table tie in with the window frames, and the soft lamp light makes the corner a cozy place to read.
